AIDifficultySetting.Name: MaxMissionFocusTime
AIDifficultySetting.Comment: How long a mission waits until it forcibly hands off the baton to a new topic. Too short and the army is re-tasked before it ever reaches the target - it never commits to a push. Duckman's AI mod uses a flat 5s and other mods run 5-10s; the old 1.5s at Heroic handed off 3.3x more often than any of them.

DataPoint.Comment: Flat 5s at every difficulty, matching Duckman's AI mod

AIDifficultySetting.Name: EconMultiplier
AIDifficultySetting.Comment: 1.00 = no econ change, 0.0 means no supplies, 2.0 means double normal supplies

AIDifficultySetting.Name: DeathMatchMultiplier
AIDifficultySetting.Comment: 1.00 = normal speed, 0.0 (illegal!!) infinitely slow training/building, 2.0 means double speed. Every tier raised 50% over its previous value to lift AI unit throughput: 1.0/1.0/1.25/1.75/2.50 -> 1.5/1.5/1.875/2.625/3.75. NOTE: the name suggests Deathmatch only; the comment says training/building generally. If AI production does not visibly speed up in normal skirmish, this dial is Deathmatch-scoped and the change is inert.

AIDifficultySetting.Name: CntPercentCounter
AIDifficultySetting.Comment: Percentage of training focused on counter units. THIS IS THE ARMY VARIETY DIAL. Counter picking runs OUTSIDE trainlist_<leader>.ai: Trigger 3043 reads the enemy's most common unit type, picks ONE counter for it, and spends this share of training on that single squad type. At 1.35 the AI spent 135% of its training - more than all of it - on one counter, which overrode the train list entirely and produced an army of a single unit no matter how the table was balanced. Rewriting the train list does nothing while this is above 1. Under 0.5 the counter is a reaction layered on top of the build order instead of replacing it.

DataPoint.Comment: Easy: 20% of training reacts to the enemy
Legendary: 45% - adapts hard, still fields the whole roster

AIDifficultySetting.Name: CntCounterCalculationRate
AIDifficultySetting.Comment: Wait time between evaluating counter units. At 0.10 the AI re-picked its counter ten times a second, so a brief change in what the enemy had on screen churned the factory queues. Duckman's AI mod runs a flat 10s. Slower is not dumber here - the counter still lands, it just stops thrashing production.

AIDifficultySetting.Name: DiffDistractionTime

DataPoint.Comment: Never spend time distracted, at any difficulty

DataPoint.Comment: Bump the build topic immediately, at any difficulty
